summary: Package deployable services as production container images and publish them to GitHub Container Registry after CI passes.
description: Package each deployable part as a multi-stage, non-root image with a healthcheck, then publish versioned images to GitHub Container Registry after CI. The instructions adapt to the selected stack, including an API and static site in one image for astro-fullstack. Local verification builds images. Choosing a host, configuring runtime secrets and rolling out containers remain separate deployment work.
seoDescription: Build non-root production container images with healthchecks and publish versioned artifacts to GHCR through GitHub Actions.

projectExamples.title: Containerized Python web app
projectExamples.description: Package the FastAPI service and React SPA as production images. Choose a runtime host and rollout process separately.

projectExamples.title: Single-image site and API
projectExamples.description: Bundle the Astro site and Node API into one image with static serving configured. Provision the host and supply runtime configuration outside the image.

plain.whatItIs: Packages each deployable part of the app as a container, a sealed bundle with what it needs, and publishes it to GitHub after checks pass.
goodAt: Building images that leave out development tools and secrets
